verdict.rationale: Working Copy's own manual has a Git submodules section ("Git submodules allow you to include other Git repositories within your repository"), which indicates first-party submodule support. The excerpt only defines submodules and does not describe how cloning, updating, or managing them works in the app. missing for 10: documented submodule clone/recursive init, documented update/sync-to-pinned-commit workflow, documented add/remove/manage operations, independent or hands-on corroboration.
